data.one_liner: Terminal string styling with builtin style functions and string extensions.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to easily color and style terminal strings using functions or string extensions. Supports combining styled and normal strings for console output.
use_when: You are building a Dart command-line application and want colored terminal output.
You want simple string extensions to quickly apply ANSI styles.
avoid_when: You are building a Flutter GUI application where terminal formatting is not visible.
You need complex UI widget libraries.
strengths: Simple API with both functional and extension-based styling methods.
weaknesses: Limited only to terminal string styling.
Not applicable for Flutter UI rendering.
data.setup_notes: Add package via 'dart pub add ansi' and import it in your Dart code.

alternatives.name: console
alternatives.why_pick_it: Another option for terminal text styling and manipulation in Dart.
